project_context.name: Impulse AI
project_context.vibe: Clean, minimal, premium — closer to Linear or Perplexity than ChatGPT. Obsidian black base, electric blue kinetic trigger.

rules: Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Body text MUST be text-base or text-sm for density.
MUST include Google Fonts import for Outfit and Manrope in index.css.

surfaces.cards: bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-none transition-all hover:bg-[#151515] hover:border-white/20
surfaces.input: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-lg focus:border-[#3b82f6] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#3b82f6]

auth.layout: Split screen layout: Left side full-height image (auth_background) with 40% black overlay. Right side minimal auth form centered.
auth.components: Shadcn Form, Input, Button. Sleek border inputs.

chat_interface.layout: Left sidebar (260px, hidden on mobile by default) + Main chat area.
chat_interface.sidebar: Contains Chat History list, Profile settings snippet at bottom, and Plan Status. The Plan Status block must display a usage counter ('8 of 10 daily messages used') visually represented with a progress bar for free users.

chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#3b82f6]/10 border border-[#3b82f6]/20 text-[#fafafa] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[80%]
chat_bubbles.ai: bg-transparent text-[#e4e4e7] rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%] border-none

chat_interface.feedback_actions: Thumbs up/down icons (lucide-react) appearing below AI messages in a small muted flex row. Subtle text-neutral-500 hover:text-white transition.
chat_interface.input_area: Fixed at bottom. Wrapper: bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 flex items-end shadow-2xl. Use textarea that auto-resizes. Submit button: Electric blue square icon button.

pricing.layout: 3-column pricing cards in a responsive grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6`). Header: text-center, H1 text-4xl to 5xl tracking-tight.

cards.pro_creative: Featured Card ($24/mo). Apply 'The Tracing Beam' or 'Glow' effect (simulated via subtle blue border: `border-[#3b82f6]/50` and glowing shadow: `shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(59,130,246,0.15)]`).

auth_background.description: Elegant abstract swirl with soft blue hues on a dark backdrop. Use as split-screen background for Auth page.

pricing_hero.description: Black and blue abstract painting. Use as subtle 10% to 15% opacity fixed background layer for Pricing page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Generate pure valid React/Tailwind code in .js / .jsx formats.
Ensure dark mode is fully enforced. The main background must be #0a0a0a globally.
Use Shadcn UI components but customize spacing and borders to match the Obsidian + Electric Blue theme.
Implement 'data-testid' on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, feedback icons, plan toggles).
Pricing page MUST implement Stripe checkout logic (mocked if necessary, but flow should be complete).
Feedback logs: create logic to handle and log {user_id, message_id, rating, timestamp} when thumbs up/down is clicked.
Chat input must handle 'Enter' to submit and 'Shift+Enter' for new line.
The counter for free users should be prominently visible in the sidebar with an upgrade button.
Strictly import and use Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts. Do NOT use Inter.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility for all text over the dark backgrounds.
